name: Watashi ga Aishita Onii-sama
source:
The protagonist wakes up one morning to find himself turned into a tentacle monster!
His parents don't recognize him and try to get rid of him; however, his 2 younger sisters sense that it is their brother.
From that day, he starts living in a closed storage.
Yet, he enjoys a sex life with his sisters while making use of his tentacles.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE064866.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
一天早晨，主人公从睡梦中醒来，却发现自己竟然变成了一只触手怪物！
父母认不出他，还试图将他赶走；然而，他的两个妹妹却感觉到，眼前的怪物正是自己的哥哥。
从那天起，他开始住在一间封闭的储物室里。
可他也利用身上的触手，与两个妹妹享受起了性生活。

[引自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE064866.html]DLsite[/url]]
